meta.definition: dynamics_model.md rev. 32 5.14.6-5.14.8 (+ V9-2 redefinition), 5.14.12 V9-1 order rule
meta.judgement: automatic pre-check; final judgement dynamics-expert. Ids: 'V7a gate', 'V7a', 'V5p3 gate', 'V9', 'V5' judged; 'V7b' record judgement (5.12.5); 'info' identification cross-check
decisions_of_this_module (definition lef: V7a gate (2) uses the per-leg maximum module elastic N increase (the side that approaches the knee); |dN| (both signs) is recorded in the case record

V7a modes: identification of run_S4.identify (projection fit + ERA, judged value of verify.s4.judged_value) on the LOCK Phi of the level; judged run per mode = the block judged_run_per_mode; zeta_num = LOCK r omega dt / 2 at the run dt
V7b first knee crossing = end time of the first module step with a LOCK <-> FLOOR change
V5 / V9-1: start value = module N of the first step and attitude of the first sample; end window = last 3 LOCK first-mode periods (12 s - 3 / f1); transient window [0.5, 3.6] s

V9-1 order: successive differences of the three coarse dt (verify.s3.order_ratio, as S3); the ratio of the errors against 1e-5 s is recorded; the judged value is read from the float32 series N_step (quantum 2**-7 N), the float64 whole-run minimum of result.json is recorded next to it

V9-1 order rule of 5.14.12 (rev. 32 suppl. 5): when the 2e-4 s transient error against 1e-5 s is <= 0.1 x 1 %, the successive ratio is recorded and the predictor-off two-dt ratio (e(2e-4) / e(1e-4) against the predictor-on 1e-5 s run, 2 +- 20 %) is judged with the V9-2 ratio confirming the order; the predictor-off ratio is judged whenever both predictor-off runs exist
V9-2: mode-1 amplitude error ratio judged (2 +- 20 %, as S3 V9-2); amplitude difference to 1e-5 s (1 % flag) and phase recorded
